project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo (shared/backend/frontend/infra) for an MLB postseason summary site. Strict TypeScript, ESM. AWS CDK + Lambda + DynamoDB + API Gateway v2 (HTTP API) + Bedrock + S3/CloudFront SPA.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts orchestrate per-workspace tsc. Node toolchain not on PATH by default: prefix commands with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". Lambda runtime target Node 20 (keep code Node 20 compatible).
test_framework: Vitest, colocated *.test.ts next to code. AWS SDK and MLB API are mocked via dependency-injection interfaces (BracketStore, fetchSchedule, BedrockInvoker). Property tests are *.property.test.ts (fast-check). Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/.
build_command: npm run build (ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra via tsc; frontend also vite build)
test_command: npm test (runs vitest across workspaces). Also npm run synth (cdk synth, real check since infra changed) and npm run test:e2e -w frontend (Playwright headless chromium --no-sandbox, regression only).
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build. 2) npm test (all workspaces green; new tests: pure cache-key function, service criterion-1 (2nd same-situation request => no Bedrock) and criterion-2 (changed win counts => fresh Bedrock) with AWS mocked, metric-helper unit test, infra throttling assertion test, any new IAM assertion). 3) npm run synth (must pass, no AWS calls). 4) npm run test:e2e -w frontend (regression only). Do NOT run cdk deploy. Do NOT make live Bedrock/MLB calls (mock everything).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. frontend/dist and backend/dist are build outputs (gitignored). cdk.out is synth output (gitignored).
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (node_modules present, baseline build already verified green). If a fresh install is needed: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm install at repo root.
environment_constraints: No live AWS or network calls anywhere (tests, build, synth all offline). cdk synth renders template in-process with a fixed env {account, region}; no credentials used. Do NOT deploy. Metrics approach must avoid new IAM if possible (prefer EMF logs over PutMetricData).
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always and MANDATORY: incremental commits on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; truthful specs (update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md) and both READMEs (README.md and README.ja.md) since spec-driven development is graded; add/update tests in the same change as behavior. Do NOT push, open PRs, create/close issues, or deploy (orchestrator owns those). Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: BracketService (backend/src/service/bracketService.ts) is the orchestration seam; all collaborators injectable (store: BracketStore, bedrockInvoker: BedrockInvoker, fetch* functions) for offline unit tests. getPrediction already short-circuits BEFORE predict/Bedrock for: results-only season (isResultsOnly), series.status==='final', and unresolvable/not-started series (returns mode 'results'|'upcoming'). The ONLY billable Bedrock path is the final branch that calls predict() + generateNarrative(). DynamoBracketStore (backend/src/store/dynamo.ts) uses single-pk table with keys BRACKET#<season>, STANDINGS#<season>, GAME#<gamePk> and numeric 'ttl'; getters return undefined and putters no-op when TABLE_NAME unset. generateNarrative has a deterministic localized fallback on any Bedrock error. Model resolved via shared resolveModelId; language defaults to DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_LANGUAGE. PredictionResponse is a discriminated union in @mlb/shared (mode: 'prediction'|'results'|'upcoming'); the 'prediction' member carries favoriteTeamId, favoriteWinProbability, narrative, model, generatedAt, metrics. Test stores use an in-memory memoryStore() mock implementing the full BracketStore interface (bracketService.test.ts) - this MUST be extended when a new store method is added. infra/test/stack.test.ts uses aws-cdk-lib/assertions Template.fromStack with a fixed env; add throttling + any-new-IAM assertions here.
relevant_files: backend/src/service/bracketService.ts (getPrediction: insert cache lookup/write around the predict+generateNarrative branch, AFTER the results-only/final/upcoming short-circuits)
backend/src/store/dynamo.ts (add getCachedPrediction/putCachedPrediction + PREDICTION# key helper + a prediction TTL constant; extend BracketStore interface)
backend/src/service/bracketService.test.ts (extend memoryStore mock with the two new methods; add criterion-1 and criterion-2 service tests)
backend/src/bedrock/narrative.ts (billable InvokeModel path; cache must wrap this)
backend/src/handlers/getPrediction.ts + backend/src/handlers/http.ts (season/seriesId/accuracy/lang/model parsing feeds the cache key; no change needed unless key inputs change)
shared/src/types.ts + shared/src/index.ts (PredictionResponse union; add a pure predictionCacheKey helper here or in backend - prefer a small pure tested function)
backend/src/metrics (NEW: EMF metric-emitting helper for cache hit/miss + Bedrock InvokeModel count, plus its unit test)
infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts (add HTTP API stage default-route throttling rate/burst; only add cloudwatch:PutMetricData IAM if PutMetricData is chosen - prefer EMF to avoid IAM)
infra/test/stack.test.ts (assert throttling rate/burst; assert new IAM if PutMetricData used)
directory_structure: shared/ (@mlb/shared domain types + seed + pure helpers), backend/ (@mlb/backend Lambda handlers, mlb client, predict model, bedrock narrative, dynamo store, bracketService), frontend/ (@mlb/frontend Vite React SPA + Playwright e2e), infra/ (@mlb/infra CDK app + assertion tests). .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/ holds spec-driven docs; .kiro/steering/ holds always-on steering; .agents/tasks/ holds feature plans.
